QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Treatment Necessities
QuestInfo.0: Alika and Janyt are looking after the wounded. You should see what you can do to help.
QuestInfo.1: Alika asked you to find Leatty Crystals they can use to treat the wounded.
QuestInfo.2: Cayne helped you find Leatty Crystals on the Frozen Snowfields. He told you healers like Janyt are called Devatas and that they are always exhausted because each healing saps an enormous amount of energy from them.

default.0: So you couldn't find Cayne? He must have left town. I heard you can find Leatty in the middle of the river though.
